The '''Holy Blade''' is a [[sword]] that can be found as a [[The Mines#Special Items|special item]] in [[the Mines]]. When wielded, it grants +4 Speed and +2 Defense and is enchanted with [[Forge#Combat enchantments|Crusader]].

==Trivia==
The Holy Blade was thought to be unobtainable until several years after the game's release.<ref name="caredditcomment" /> Since {{Version|v1.6}}, the Holy Blade may be found in [[the Mines]] starting from level 80.
